run_gen_color_mapping: run the python script to generate a color mapping CSV from a model category file
run_gen_color_mapping_custom_key: run the python script with a custom key to generate color mappings for fine-grained classes
get_all_classes: get all unique model classes from a CSV file including extra classes like Ground and Ceiling
generate_colors_custom: generate a list of RGB colors from predefined palettes for up to 256 classes
review_gen_color_mapping: review the python script that generates RGB color mappings for 3D model semantic classes
